evaluation.feedback: This is an impressive first attempt. I really enjoyed the modern, high-energy trap influence. The rhythmic vocal chops add a lot of character and catchiness, and the production quality feels professional. The syncopation in the percussion keeps the track feeling dynamic and fresh throughout.
